subject: Pilot credit and operational commitment for Community Data Coop
messages:
From: Ana Morales <ana@communitydatacoop.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Peter Huang <phuang@stateuniv.edu>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit request and ask for operational commitment - Community Data Coop

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking a moment to speak yesterday. Community Data Coop is a small nonprofit consortium of three community colleges and one municipal open-data lab. We're running a 12-week research pilot to build an anonymized neighborhood recommendation model for resource routing (safety nets, food access). Our IRB has approved the limited evaluation; the code and evaluation sets will be open-sourced.

Given our budget constraints, we're requesting a promotional credit allocation to cover inference costs for the pilot: roughly 250k tokens/month for 3 months, plus a short-term Dedicated reservation (one small instance equivalent) for the evaluation period to keep latency consistent while students run experiments. The two parts are:
- Promotional compute credit: 750k tokens total across 3 months
- Short Dedicated reservation: 1x small GPU for 12 weeks at reduced monthly rate or credit offset

We can sign a simple MOU and are flexible on timing; a PO from the lead college would be possible. Attached is a brief pilot scope and our IRB summary. Could Redwood provide a provisional credits commitment and a pointer to the procurement steps? We are hoping to launch the pilot in mid-October.

Best,
Ana Morales
Program Director
Community Data Coop
attachments: CDC_Pilot_Scope_v1.pdf, IRB_Approval_Summary.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ana Morales <ana@communitydatacoop.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request and ask for operational commitment - Community Data Coop

Hi Ana — great to meet you over Zoom. Really appreciate the IRB and the open-source plan.

High level next steps I can commit to from the Redwood side:
1) We can provisionally earmark up to $2,500 in hosted credits (covers the 750k token ask) while we finalize the MOU/PO.
2) For the Dedicated reservation request, we can offer a 12-week trial Dedicated seat at a reduced rate contingent on a signed MOU; our finance team will need a simple PO or commitment letter from the lead institution.

To move forward I need three things:
- Confirmed pilot start/end dates and an approximate daily token profile (sample days with expected peak).
- A signed MOU or a draft (if you want us to start with our template we can).
- SOC2 summary and any specific security questions your procurement team requires (we have a one-page security snapshot and can produce a scoped data processing addendum).

Looping in Marissa from Partnerships to authorize the credit earmark and Ben from Sales to coordinate the Dedicated reservation details & procurement steps. If you can share the PO timeline that helps us align finance approvals.

I'll create a short MOU template and share it by Monday.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you launched.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Ana Morales <ana@communitydatacoop.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Peter Huang <phuang@stateuniv.edu>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request and ask for operational commitment - Community Data Coop

Thanks Soojin — excellent, and that's encouraging. A few clarifications:
- Pilot window: Oct 18, 2027 — Jan 7, 2028 (12 weeks).
- Expected token profile: mostly bursts during student lab hours; estimate 6k–10k tokens/day on weekdays, with spikes up to 40k on scheduled lab runs (sample attached).
- Procurement: the lead institution (Eastside Community College) can issue a PO within 2–3 weeks; do you need vendor paperwork in advance?

Attached is a draft MOU that our counsel prepared (CDC_MOU_Draft.docx) and the IRB summary you have. We are comfortable with the SOC2 snapshot flow you mentioned but can send specific procurement Qs if needed.

Also, are there any usage caps or auto-throttle settings you recommend to avoid accidental overage during student runs?

Best,
Ana
attachments: CDC_MOU_Draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ana Morales <ana@communitydatacoop.org>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request and ask for operational commitment - Community Data Coop

Hi Ana — welcomed the details. Quick confirmations from Redwood:

1) Credits: We will provisionally commit $2,500 in hosted credits against the pilot, effective once Soojin's team receives an executed MOU or a signed commitment email from the lead PO contact. Credits will be applied to the account tied to the PO email.

2) Dedicated seat: We can stand up a small Dedicated reservation for the 12-week window. Commercial terms: Redwood will discount the standard short-term Dedicated rate by 35% for this non-profit research pilot. Final activation requires a PO or a mutually signed MOU so Finance can approve.

3) Procurement & vendor paperwork: Ben — can you please confirm the vendor packet we need to send Eastside Community College? Ana, we will include our W-9, standard subcontractor terms, SOC2 snapshot, and a short data processing addendum.

4) Auto-throttle & safety: We recommend setting a hard daily token cap with soft alerts at 70% so we can work with your instructors. Our console supports per-project quotas and token-based alerts; Ben can send a quick setup guide.

If that all sounds good, we can prepare the MOU (I reviewed your draft and suggest two small clarifications around liability and data retention — I'll markup and send today).

Marissa
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor_packet_placeholder.zip (W-9, SOC2-snapshot.pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ana Morales <ana@communitydatacoop.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request and ask for operational commitment - Community Data Coop

Ana — I'll drop the vendor packet into the Drive link (same HubSpot record HSP-48291) and include a short procurement checklist for Eastside Community College:
- Signed MOU or PO (scanned)
- Billing contact + email for account setup
- Vendor paperwork: W-9 (for US), Redwood subcontractor terms, SOC2 snapshot, DPA excerpt
- Invoice cadence preference (monthly or one-time at activation)

For the Dedicated seat, we'll provision capacity the week before your start date so you have a dry-run. To avoid surprises, I recommend configuring the console quota to 50k/day hard cap initially; we can loosen it after the first week.

I'll post the Drive folder link here once uploaded, and we can mark the HubSpot deal as 'Provisioning: vendor docs pending'.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
